summary: Same real weights, DP1xTP8, fixed c12/DSpark7, 64 cycles, no profiler, post-window exact state/mirror validation. Target graph replay improves internal decode-window TPS 38.2709->294.3999 (+669.2%) and cycle wall 433.587->53.286 ms (-87.71%). This is a valid runtime-window A/B, not comparable to the Stock 48-request HTTP E2E baseline.
